name: Hibiscus
description: The exquisite Chinese-style sachet is made of beautiful flower elements and butterfly shapes with various postures. It contains condensation pills. The fragrance is fresh and intoxicating, refreshing the heart and mind. It can be used as a waist accessory. The jade steps are graceful, the brocade butterfly is swaying gently, and the belt is fragrant. It has a unique oriental elegance.
